officialText:
Section 770.25 – Revise Section 770.25 to read as follows:

770.25 Abandoned Cables, Power Sources and Other Associated Equipment. The accessible portion of abandoned optical fiber and other cables, power sources, and other associated equipment shall be removed. Where cables are identified for future use with a tag, such tag shall be of sufficient durability to withstand the environment involved. Power sources and other associated equipment tagged for future use shall be de-energized.
